text: Ancient Egyptian civilization grew along the Nile, whose floods made farming reliable. Pharaohs ruled as god-kings and commanded vast building projects. The pyramids of Giza were tombs built with astonishing precision around 2560 BCE. Hieroglyphic writing recorded taxes, prayers, and history.
